plan.goal: Retrieve UniProt sequences annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0070204) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0070205) molecular functions, run compositional and motif-level sequence analysis on each enzyme family, then aggregate representative sequences and annotations into a ranked candidate list using VPA tools only.
assumptions: GO:0070204 is taken as the canonical MF term for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (NAXD family) based on tool-selection evidence; if go_sequences returns zero sequences, the correct term should be resolved from lit_nadhpx_repair output and the node re-run.
GO:0070205 is taken as the canonical MF term for NADPHX epimerase activity (NAXE family); same fallback applies.
reviewed=true restricts retrieval to manually curated Swiss-Prot entries to maximise annotation reliability.
max_sequences=200 per GO term is expected to cover the full reviewed sequence space for these relatively small enzyme families.
sequence_analysis is run at physiological pH 7.4; all region and residue-level annotations are enabled for both families.
rank_designs operates without upstream structure predictions; scoring derives entirely from sequence_analysis representative_sequences as candidates and per-family top_annotations as scoring context.

Dehydratase representative_sequences constitute the primary candidate pool for rank_designs; epimerase top_annotations provide orthogonal functional-annotation context via analyses; dehydratase top_annotations are included as qc_results for within-family scoring consistency.
literature_search runs in parallel with go_sequences and does not gate downstream nodes; it supplies biological context for interpreting ranked output.
top_k=20 is sufficient to surface the most representative candidates across the combined enzyme family space given reviewed-only retrieval.

success_criteria.literature_context_retrieved: lit_nadhpx_repair returns at least 5 records on NAD(P)HX repair biology with abstracts
success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences_retrieved: go_dehydratase returns non-empty fasta_path and kept_sequences > 0 for GO:0070204
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences_retrieved: go_epimerase returns non-empty fasta_path and kept_sequences > 0 for GO:0070205
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_nadhpx_candidates produces ranked_candidates with up to 20 entries combining dehydratase sequence features and epimerase annotation context
